name: specstream
description: Live web data engine for teams and agents. Includes web search (Search API), page extraction (Extract API), structured Deep Search lists with source URLs, cited research reports, and scheduled monitoring.

SPECSTREAM_API_KEY.description: SpecStream API key from https://specstream.ai/workspace (Agents & API). Required for Bearer header auth and the local stdio bridge; optional when using OAuth.

uvx.description: Local stdio bridge via PyPI (specstream-mcp-stdio) forwarding to https://api.specstream.ai/mcp.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Sign in with OAuth in OAuth-capable MCP clients.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint using a SpecStream API key as a Bearer token.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search the live web for a quick answer or initial rows with source URLs.

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: Extract clean Markdown or plain text from up to 20 web pages or documents (PDF, Word, Excel).

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Parse a plain-language request for a structured web list into conditions and columns.

tools.name: quote_new_list
tools.description: Price a compiled web list request before any paid work runs.

tools.name: run_new_list
tools.description: Start building a quoted web list after approval of the maximum cost.

tools.name: get_find
tools.description: Read the status, progress, and cost so far of a running or completed list.

tools.name: list_find_rows
tools.description: Read delivered rows from a list with source URLs and read times.

tools.name: export_find
tools.description: Generate a download link for a list in CSV, Excel, JSON, HTML, KML, or GeoJSON.

tools.name: research_price
tools.description: Check the price of a cited research report at quick, standard, or deep depth.

tools.name: start_research
tools.description: Start a cited Markdown or JSON research report from the live web.

tools.name: get_research
tools.description: Read the progress or completed output and citations of a research report.

tools.name: get_capacity_balance
tools.description: Read the account balance, held amount, and monthly spending limit usage.

examples.title: Web search
examples.description: Search the live web for a quick answer with sources

examples.title: Read web pages

examples.title: Build a structured list
examples.description: Compile and price a live web search into structured rows
examples.prompt: Compile a SpecStream list of active US climate-tech grants with deadlines and URLs, and show me the quote before running.

examples.title: Cited research report
